name: hitodama
description: A pocket yokai that lives in a pane beside the Claude Code chat and grows from how you look after it, reacting to how you work: context, effort, limits, helpers.

language.title: Language
language.description: Interface language: auto follows Claude Code's language setting (English if it is none of these); or en English, ru Русский, zh 中文, ja 日本語, ko 한국어, es Español, pt Português, de Deutsch, fr Français.

colourScreen.title: Colour screen
colourScreen.description: A dark screen with each yokai in its own colour. Off, the screen is two greys, as on a pocket LCD.

colourBars.title: Colour bars
colourBars.description: The bars under the screen coloured by level: green, yellow, red.

smallPixels.title: Small pixels
smallPixels.description: On a screen wider than 32 columns, the picture smoothed to twice the pixels, each half as big.

itemColours.title: Item colours
itemColours.description: On the coloured screen, things around the pet in colours by kind: food yellow, droppings brown, sleep white, hearts pink, medicine blue, alarms red. Off, all yellow.

scenery.title: Scenery
scenery.description: On the coloured screen, the ground under the pet, clouds by day and stars by night.

particles.title: Particles
particles.description: On the coloured screen, hearts rising while the pet eats or walks.

detail.title: Detail
detail.description: Screen detail: pixel, 32 × 24 pixels; braille, the picture smoothed and drawn in braille dots, four times as many in the same space.
